panels.title: Volume hebdo moyen
panels.description: Moyenne du volume des semaines entraînées dans la période (une semaine sans série ne compte pas). Selon l'interrupteur « Échauffement », avec ou sans les séries d'échauffement.

targets.queryText:
SELECT AVG(volume) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(w.volume) AS volume
  FROM ${echauffement} w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
  WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY w.week_ts
)
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT AVG(volume) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(w.volume) AS volume

  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug

panels.title: Volume par semaine
panels.description: Reps × charge des séries de travail, semaine par semaine (lundi UTC). La ligne pointillée est la moyenne des semaines entraînées de la période. Selon l'interrupteur « Échauffement », avec ou sans les séries d'échauffement.

targets.queryText:
SELECT week_ts AS time, volume, AVG(volume) OVER () AS moyenne
FROM (
  SELECT w.week_ts, SUM(w.volume) AS volume
  FROM ${echauffement} w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
  WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY w.week_ts
)
ORDER BY week_ts
targets.rawQueryText:

panels.title: Records par exercice

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       s.name AS Séance,
       MAX(w.weight) AS "Charge max",
       ROUND(MAX(w.weight * (1 + w.reps / 30.0)), 1) AS "1RM estimé",
       COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) AS Journées,
       COUNT(*) AS Séries,
       MAX(w.completed_ts) AS Dernière
FROM working_sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
GROUP BY w.seance_slug, w.exercise_slug
ORDER BY "Charge max" DESC

panels.title: Échauffement par exercice
panels.description: Sur combien de journées chaque exercice a été échauffé, et ce que ça pèse. Un exercice lourd rarement échauffé mérite un coup d'œil.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN w.day END) AS "Échauffées",
       COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) AS Journées,
       SUM(w.is_warmup) AS "Séries",
       SUM(CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN w.volume ELSE 0 END) AS "Volume",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN w.volume ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(w.volume), 0) AS Part
FROM sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
GROUP BY w.seance_slug, w.exercise_slug
ORDER BY "Échauffées" * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) DESC, "Volume" DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN w.day END) AS "Échauffées",
       COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) AS Journées,
       SUM(w.is_warmup) AS "Séries",
       SUM(CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN w.volume ELSE 0 END) AS "Volume",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN w.volume ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(w.volume), 0) AS Part
FROM sets w

WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
GROUP BY w.seance_slug, w.exercise_slug
ORDER BY "Échauffées" * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) DESC, "Volume" DESC

panels.title: Toutes les séries

targets.queryText:
SELECT w.completed_ts AS Date,
       s.name AS Séance,
       COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       w.reps AS Reps,
       w.weight AS Charge,
       w.volume AS Volume,
       CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN 'échauffement' ELSE 'travail' END AS Type
FROM sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
ORDER BY w.completed_ts DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT w.completed_ts AS Date,
       s.name AS Séance,
       COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       w.reps AS Reps,
       w.weight AS Charge,
       w.volume AS Volume,
       CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN 'échauffement' ELSE 'travail' END AS Type
FROM sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
ORDER BY w.completed_ts DESC

panels.description: Séries de travail et d'échauffement, de la plus récente à la plus ancienne.
